research.title: Robustness of Surface Defect Segmentation Under Illumination Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to assess how illumination augmentation affects convolutional segmentation models trained on images of manufactured surfaces.
Compared augmentation settings using overlap metrics, boundary accuracy, and error inspection, separating lighting sensitivity from failures associated with small defects.

publications.title: Illumination Augmentation for Surface Defect Segmentation: A Controlled Evaluation
Boundary and Small-Defect Errors in Surface Segmentation Under Lighting Shift

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented corner detection, patch descriptors, and robust homography estimation to align image pairs with overlapping views.
Compared descriptor normalization and matching thresholds using reprojection errors and visual inspection of alignment failures under rotation and brightness changes.

projects.title: Transfer Learning for Fine-Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine-tuning baselines for distinguishing visually similar object categories using a pretrained convolutional network.
Evaluated classification performance across training configurations, inspecting confusion matrices and misclassified images to characterize background dependence and subtle appearance differences.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Denoising Methods
bullets: Implemented median filtering, bilateral filtering, and a convolutional denoising baseline for images corrupted by synthetic impulse and Gaussian noise.
Compared reconstruction quality using peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting edge preservation and texture smoothing across noise conditions.
